svg.title: The market at seven, down the hill
svg.desc: A street market early in the morning with six stalls, open crates, a van being unloaded, a queue of four people at one stall and nobody at the identical stall beside it.

g.text: The market at seven, down the hill
Fourteen things to find. Two of the stalls are selling the same thing at the same price.
the shop at the top of the street - open all day
the bakery, two streets away - baked at five
the shop - a fridge, a card machine
the sign: two euros twenty a kilo
a queue of four, at seven
the stall with the handwritten sign
the same tomatoes, the same price
nineteen years here, and nobody in front of her
